name: Old television / CRT treatment
summary: A desaturated, flickering base with a connected overlay in a blend mode, evoking a CRT display.
creativeJobs: place a moment in the past
suggest a mediated or recorded image
add texture to a clean source
qualityChecks: flicker reads as a display artefact rather than a render error
the overlay does not obscure a protected region
blend mode survives the round trip
failureModes: flicker fast enough to raise a photosensitivity concern
an overlay offset measured against the timeline instead of the parent clip, which silently misplaces it
safety: check against the three-flashes-per-second threshold before shipping any flicker

provenance.claim: Final Cut supports blend modes on connected clips
a connected clip is a child of the spine asset-clip with lane=1 and a parent-relative offset; blend mode is written as an index-and-name string
content should not flash more than three times per second

validation.notes: Generalized emitter admitted 2026-08-07 for the base treatment. A generated package imported without error and returned intact: the three-keyframe flicker in the animated param form with movie-origin times, and the Color Adjustments filter with its UID and payloads preserved. Not established: the connected overlay was NOT exercised in this pass because the plan role model carries no overlay asset, so lane, parent-relative offset, and blend mode remain admitted only from the earlier probe rather than from this emitter. Only the Overlay blend mode has ever been observed.
verifiedOn: clip-a.mov colour bars, base treatment without an overlay
